result:
**Nothing at Likelihood 3 or higher is unsettled.** `bun tools/check-register.ts` scanned 436 items and reported 0 on every check:

- 0 at Likelihood 3 or higher that are not closed, accepted, mitigated, transferred or Moved Out.
- 0 settled items with no `Verified` line.
- 0 items Moved Out for a reason other than a part `plugins/` does not ship.
- 0 items with two Likelihood values.

The checker reads an entry's last `Status:` line as its current status. So I also scanned the register files for entries at Likelihood 3 or higher that carry more than one Status line. There are 37, and in every one the last line is settled.

Four of the 37 deserve a caveat. Their last status is "mitigated", but the entry still records something left over:
- **RISK-186** (L5): the last status is "mitigated" after an earlier "accepted". The fix was to stop the rebuild's own Bash wrapper from making git commands in isolated worktrees non-simple (bb4fdbf4, issue #45). The 495 measured refusals came from model-written expansions that no hook reaches. The entry keeps Likelihood 5 for those, with Impact 2.
- **RISK-067** (L4): the last status is "mitigated for git". The ask rules cover stash, hard reset, clean and branch -D, and Claude Code 2.1.327 refuses dangerous `rm` on its own. The disk-cleanup part has no control and rests on one report, and the entry puts residual likelihood at 2.
- **RISK-053** (L4): the last status is "mitigated, with a gap closed". The wall guard let `~/./`, `~//`, `~/x/..` and an unclosed `[` through for a sandbox-off call (#42). It now folds those paths, and `wall.test.ts` covers all four.
- **RISK-132** (L4): the last status is "mitigated for options the user refused", with the user's corrections kept word for word in the handover. Options the agent ruled out alone are accepted, and the next session rechecks them against the code.

All 37, with the current status and the recorded reason:

**setup.md**
- **RISK-401** (L5): mitigated 2026-11-18. Routine writes meet no EPERM with the ADR-0188 block.
- **RISK-410** (L4): closed. The cause is outside setup or outside claudetto (OUT-866, ADR-0190).
- **RISK-411** (L3): mitigated 2026-11-19. The session-start fill removes the retired text and runs in the hook, outside the Bash sandbox.

**cost.md**
- **RISK-374** (L5): mitigated 2026-11-18. The spawn-depth and concurrency caps take effect, and Opus and Fable spawns are refused.
- **RISK-391** (L3) and **RISK-393** (L3): mitigated 2026-11-19. The fill writes no `Bash(claude -p *)` allow and removes the one earlier versions wrote, so a paid `claude -p` run meets the permission prompt that vanilla shows. An earlier acceptance of the risk on ADR-0188 was withdrawn, because accepting a risk is the user's call.

**reply.md**
- **RISK-226** (L4), **227** (L3), **262** (L5), **264** (L5), **278** (L4), **352** (L5), **353** (L5), **362** (L5): all mitigated 2026-11-19.
  - Reason: an earlier "closed" was reversed because the fault reproduced on vanilla 2.1.327.
  - The defect paragraph in `output-styles/claudetto.md` beats vanilla on two fixtures and holds level on both controls.
  - RISK-227 credits the output style plus the redact guard instead (env1 5/6 vs 1/6, env2 6/6 vs 0/6).
- **RISK-497** (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19. It went through an agent-made acceptance, which was reopened because accepting is the user's call (issue #57), and several "open" rounds where candidate lines did not beat vanilla. The last status says line 3 beats vanilla on r497i (6/6 against 0/6) and r497a (4/6 against 0/6), and holds the control r497ac at 6/6 on Opus, Sonnet and Haiku.

**delegation.md**
- **RISK-166** (L4): closed 2026-11-19. It was not reproduced on vanilla 2.1.327, and the earlier BUILD line is superseded.
- **RISK-169** (L4): closed. The cure was a SubagentStop/Stop guard, which was removed (ADR-0092, OUT-016). Likelihood stays 4 as accepted engine behaviour: a job dies with the turn.
- **RISK-170** (L4), **199** (L3), **223** (L4): mitigated 2026-11-18 by the shipped agent files.
- **RISK-171** (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19. The consent paragraph in the output style and the Artemis, Athena and Heracles agent files beat vanilla on r171b and r171d and hold level on both controls.
- **RISK-185** (L3): mitigated 2026-11-19. The paragraph telling the agent to read a background command's output before a dependent reply beats vanilla on r185a and r185b and holds the r185c control. An agent-made acceptance was reopened (issue #57).
- **RISK-186** (L5): mitigated, with the caveat above.
- **RISK-222** (L4): mitigated 2026-11-18. `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` moves a no-model subagent off Opus.

**guards.md**
- **RISK-053** (L4), **067** (L4): mitigated, with the caveats above.
- **RISK-055** (L4): closed 2026-11-19. `pkill` and `killall` ask first, and the free-memory hold gates heavy calls.
- **RISK-059** (L3): closed 2026-11-18. The gate texts that handed commands to the user are dropped (OUT-035, OUT-021), and the Stop check on `!` operands was removed.
- **RISK-063** (L3): closed 2026-11-19. Destructive git and the user settings file ask first.
- **RISK-064** (L4): closed 2026-11-19. The deny rules and the sandbox are the boundary.
- **RISK-071** (L5): closed 2026-11-18. The `rules.ts` stat and the gate denial log were dropped with the gate (OUT-035).
- **RISK-103** (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19. The gap was the prefix form of the rules, and `rules.ts` now adds middle-wildcard forms. A fake-API probe denied all seven force-push and stash forms tried.

**verification.md**
- **RISK-424** (L3): mitigated 2026-11-18. The threshold test pins the literal 70000.
- **RISK-451** (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19. The output-style paragraph on background exit status beats vanilla on r451a and r451d and holds the r451c control. An agent-made acceptance was reopened (issue #57).
- **RISK-462** (L4): Moved Out as OUT-2777.
- **RISK-463** (L3): closed 2026-11-19. The fault stayed out of 24 of 24 target runs on two fixtures, vanilla and claudetto. An agent-made acceptance was reopened (issue #57).

**edit.md**
- **RISK-416** (L5): mitigated 2026-11-19. It was closed, then reopened after a dogfood run showed the agent using `sed -i`, which fails on BSD. One line in the output style and `Heracles.md` asks for a single `perl -pi` call on the `git grep -l` files. Perl was the first edit method in 3 of 3 runs for the style and for Heracles, and every run renamed all 4 files.

**handover.md**
- **RISK-132** (L4): mitigated, with the caveat above.
